run_test_video_model: run multi-view testing on a pretrained Timesformer video classification model with a config file
perform_test_classification: perform multi-view testing that samples N clips from videos and averages softmax scores across views
perform_test_detection: perform fully-convolutional detection testing on full frames without cropping using the model
test_with_tensorboard: test the video model with Tensorboard logging enabled for visualization of evaluation metrics
save_test_results: save prediction results and labels to a pickle file after running multi-view testing
